tagline: Cloud Postgres projects and branches for remote teammates — SQL runs need your approval.
requirements: Set NEON_API_KEY in the host environment, from a Neon API key scoped to the intended organization or projects. This is the official server from Neon; it manages the control plane and can run SQL against branches.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.note: Lists projects the key can reach.

tools.name: list_organizations
tools.note: Lists organizations.

tools.name: list_shared_projects
tools.note: Lists projects shared with the key.

tools.name: describe_project
tools.note: Reads project details.

tools.name: describe_branch
tools.note: Reads branch details.

tools.name: list_branch_computes
tools.note: Lists computes for a branch.

tools.name: get_database_tables
tools.note: Lists tables in a branch database.

tools.name: describe_table_schema
tools.note: Reads a table's schema.

tools.name: explain_sql_statement
tools.note: Explains a query plan without executing it.

tools.name: list_slow_queries
tools.note: Reads the consumer-side slow query history.

tools.name: run_sql
tools.note: Executes SQL against a branch — the statement can write data.

tools.name: run_sql_transaction
tools.note: Executes a SQL transaction — statements can write.

tools.name: get_connection_string
tools.note: Returns a connection string containing credentials.

tools.name: create_branch
tools.note: Creates database branches.

tools.name: delete_branch
tools.note: Deletes branches and their data.

tools.name: reset_from_parent
tools.note: Overwrites a branch with its parent's data.

tools.name: create_project
tools.note: Creates projects.

tools.name: delete_project
tools.note: Deletes projects.

tools.name: prepare_database_migration
tools.note: Starts a schema migration by creating a backup branch.

tools.name: complete_database_migration
tools.note: Finishes a migration and deletes the backup branch.

tools.name: provision_neon_auth
tools.note: Provisions Neon Auth for a project.

seo.description: Share the official Neon MCP server with MCPWire. Configure an API key on the host, let teammates inspect Postgres projects and schemas over P2P, and keep SQL runs and branch writes behind approval.
